# Lumen 2.1.1

Mostly a bug-squashing and hardening release. After shipping `2.1.0`, I ran through a few thorough testing passes and a security audit across the desktop app, CLI, and installer, so this round focuses on catching weird edge cases before they trip you up—broken flag overrides, missing photo dates, half-cancelled dialogs, and a few places where security checks needed tightening.

---

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Linux ARM64 Support (Desktop & CLI): Official releases now include native `linux-arm64` builds for both the desktop app (`.AppImage`, `.deb`, and standalone binary) and `lumen-cli`, so ARM Linux desktops and headless VMs no longer need to compile from source.
- Date Recovery from Filenames: Photos and videos sent through messaging apps or saved as screenshots often lose their camera timestamps along the way. When you enable date-from-filename, Lumen now reads standard date patterns straight out of filenames (like `IMG_YYYYMMDD`, `PXL_` names, dashed dates, and social-app timestamps) so those memories land in the right spot on your timeline.
- Live Photo Pairing & Cleanup Safety: Paired videos that store their Apple metadata near the end of the file used to get skipped during matching, leaving half a Live Photo behind. Lumen now catches trailing metadata blocks properly, and if a Live Photo upload is only partially skipped as a duplicate, it keeps your local copy on disk instead of deleting an incomplete pair.
- CLI Flag Overrides Actually Override: Passing explicit "off" switches on the command line (like `--recursive=false` or `--saver=false`) used to lose against `true` values stored in your saved preferences. Command-line flags now take precedence for that run instead of silently sticking to your saved defaults.
- System Tray Fallback Guard: On desktops where a system tray isn't available, having "Minimize to tray" turned on could hide Lumen completely when you closed the window with no tray icon left to bring it back. Lumen now checks whether the tray actually initialized before letting window-close hide the app.
- Update Checker Cache & Proxy Fixes: Automatic and manual update checks now share the same checker, honor your configured proxy settings, keep cached release notes intact when nothing changed on GitHub, and handle `-dev` or pre-release version tags accurately when checking if an update is newer.
- Smoother Resume & Error Reporting: Tightened upload pause, resume, and retry state per account so interrupted batches pick back up cleanly without mixing account errors, and surfaced scan failures as real error toasts instead of letting them fail quietly.
- Localized Status & Notifications: Finished wiring live worker thread labels ("Uploading...", "Hashing..."), cancelled backup banners, and OS desktop notifications through the translation layer so switching to Spanish, Indonesian, or Japanese covers everything instead of slipping back into English.

---

### Interface & Dialog Polish
- Album Dialog Cancel Actually Cancels: Opening the album picker, toggling modes or typing a draft name, and then hitting Cancel used to leave your temporary edits sticking around. Lumen now snapshots your earlier selection and restores it cleanly when you back out.
- Album Nicknames Keep Casing & Stay Per-Account: Custom album nicknames used to get flattened to lowercase or look mixed up when managing watched folders across multiple accounts. Your capitalization stays intact, and each watched folder pulls nicknames only from its own account.
- Failed Saves Roll Back Instead of Lying: Toggling folder settings or automatic update checks when a save fails now reverts the switch back to its real state and pops up an error toast instead of leaving the UI out of sync with disk.
- Keyboard Navigation in Popups: Added proper focus trapping and `Escape`-to-close behavior across modals and dialogs so pressing `Tab` cycles inside the active popup instead of wandering behind the backdrop.

---

### Security Hardening
- Stricter Google Browser Sign-In Cookie Checks: Automated browser login used to match any cookie containing `"google"` in its domain name and pass it through the general auth parser. It now requires an HTTPS-only `oauth_token` cookie from an actual `google.com` domain and always runs the full Google token verification step instead of accepting raw credential strings from a browser cookie.
- Safer Windows Legacy Cleanup & Elevation: When checking for older pre-2.0 installations on Windows, the installer used to resolve PowerShell and legacy folders from editable user environment variables before asking for administrator access. It now reads trusted Windows OS folders directly from system settings, avoids recursing through directory junctions, and cleans up per-user shortcuts without prompting for admin rights when nothing system-wide needs removal.
- Pinned Build & Release Workflows: Every external GitHub Action used to compile, check, and publish Lumen across `.github/workflows` is now pinned to an exact verified commit ID rather than a mutable tag or branch, preventing upstream tag changes from altering official builds.

---
